subject.title: [Feature]: Align on macOS remote Gateway UX before broader PRs

question: Should macOS remote mode proceed as the proposed split after the PortGuardian cleanup, and what exact boundaries should discovery-assisted setup, remote diagnostics, and remote lifecycle controls use?
rationale: Current main implements the conservative tunnel cleanup slice, but the remaining work changes discovery trust, displayed remote state, and remote control authority, which needs maintainer product/security intent rather than an autonomous fix lane.

options.title: Keep split PR path
options.body: Treat this issue as the design umbrella and review narrow PRs for discovery trust, diagnostics, and lifecycle semantics one at a time with live macOS proof.

options.title: Require one design PR first
options.body: Pause the related implementation PRs until a maintainer-owned design change defines the full macOS remote-mode UX and security contract.

options.title: Limit to tunnel cleanup for now
options.body: Accept the landed PortGuardian work and explicitly defer discovery-assisted setup, diagnostics, and remote lifecycle controls until stronger demand appears.

recommendation.title: Keep split PR path
recommendation.body: Treat this issue as the design umbrella and review narrow PRs for discovery trust, diagnostics, and lifecycle semantics one at a time with live macOS proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete recently landed the PortGuardian slice and is the strongest current-history owner for the partially implemented remote tunnel behavior.
